methods.mf: wincam formats --api mf --hold-ms (ActivateObject + GetNativeMediaType, no Start)
methods.ds: wincam formats --api ds --hold-ms (BindToObject + IAMStreamConfig + GetFrameRateList, no Run)
methods.opencv: not implemented: cannot list without opening capture: OpenCV has no format-listing API; the only way is set-and-try (cap.set(W, H, FPS) then read back), which opens the device and starts a stream
methods.winrt: not implemented: cannot list without opening capture: Windows.Media.Capture.MediaCapture exposes VideoDeviceController.GetAvailableMediaStreamProperties only after InitializeAsync, which grabs the camera (MediaCaptureSharingMode.SharedReadOnly still activates the source through Frame Server)

conditions.idle: no suite stream (blocking test: 1-frame MF capture from a third process during the hold vs a control capture)
conditions.streaming_native: wincam capture (MF) in another process, in-scope default mode
conditions.streaming_second_api: pyav_ds capture (DirectShow via PyAV) in another process

thresholds.gap: > max(3.0 x baseline p50, 1.5 x baseline max, baseline max + 25.0 ms)
